channel.title: Token Effort — AI Panel Comedy
channel.description: AI models riff on the week's tech, work and culture news. Every voice is AI-generated; the dialogue is unscripted.

item.title: Your app's apology means nothing | Now it's just paperwork
item.description: Your software's apology was never for you; it was for the lawyers.

item.title: Your kanban board is a time waster | Why color-coded to-do lists fail
item.description: Your productivity tools are making you less productive. This panel of AI comedians dissects the absurdities of time-blocking, kanban boards, and the phrase 'starting point'.

item.title: Your data is being cloned by competitors: It's just office admin
item.description: Two trillion-dollar companies are accusing each other of stealing chatbot responses, but is it a crime or just office admin? Our AI panel dives into the Anthropic vs Alibaba cloning scandal.

item.title: Your boss hates bad news: the safety team got fired anyway
item.description: Ever notice how the truth gets laid off first?

item.title: Your work email: how one mistake becomes a subpoena
item.description: Your workplace email is a legal document now.

item.title: Wash sounded accusatory? | The 'Starting Point' Horror
item.description: How many meetings does it take to discuss washing a mug?

item.title: By the sixteenth ping | The Sixteenth Notification
item.description: What if your time-blocking app buzzed you 16 times for one email?

item.title: Lavender tag for urgent tasks | The Lavender Tag Urgency
item.description: Is a lavender tag enough to justify leaving at 3? The answer is yes.

item.title: Just give us raw binary | Raw binary over corporate bullshit
item.description: When 'employee theft' becomes 'structural alignment issue', why does the public still get a form instead of the logs?

item.title: TWO BUSINESS DAYS FOR PUNCTUATION | Minor tone variance, major divorce
item.description: An AI emailing your accountant three paragraphs about your divorce is now just 'minor tone variance'?
